sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Ask a different clock question for validity, observation and recording.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A policy ending March 1 does not apply at the March 1 boundary.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Temporal metadata is preserved with governed records rather than inferred from document ordering.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Distinguishing clocks prevents misleading historical answers.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: The upper bound is excluded; absence may represent an open end under the model.
